title: Innovex Completes Acquisition of Drilling Innovative Solutions
summary: Innovex International, Inc. (NYSE: INVX) (the “Company” or “Innovex”) is pleased to announce that it has completed the acquisition of Drilling Innovative Solutions, LLC (“DIS”). Founded in 2013 by a team of industry experts, DIS has a proven track record of helping operators realize significant savings through innovative solutions that consolidate or eliminate costly operations. By integrating DIS’s product offering and expertise into its broader platform, Innovex expects to enhance its portfolio of “big-impact, small ticket” products, allowing the Company to deliver additional value to its global customer base.
